@graph.name: Marin Learn PPTX Release Conformance
@graph.abstract: A deliberately broad Marin Learn package used for PowerPoint release acceptance testing.
@graph.description: Release fixture covering slide layouts, display modes, real text, lists, links, tables, informative and decorative images, Unicode, and speaker notes.

@graph.name: Learning objectives
@graph.description: Objectives for the MarinOS Foundations learning set.

@graph.name: Explain what MarinOS is and why it exists.
Explain the role of the Marin App Shell.
Apply the single-source principle to documents, quizzes, and slides.
Recognize accessibility, security, and maintainability as default quality requirements.
What is MarinOS?
@graph.abstract: MarinOS is a shared approach for building small, consistent, maintainable County web applications.

@graph.name: Core principles
@graph.abstract: MarinOS favors focused applications, shared standards, open technologies, and content that can be maintained.

@graph.name: The Marin App Shell
@graph.abstract: The App Shell provides shared application structure, identity, navigation, status, and policy links.

@graph.name: Single-source learning content
@graph.abstract: Canonical content is written once and assembled into reading, quiz, and presentation experiences.

@graph.name: Accessibility and security by default
@graph.abstract: Accessibility and security are built into authoring, validation, rendering, and package handling.

@graph.name: A practical authoring workflow
@graph.abstract: Authors create objectives, reusable content, materials, questions, and slides, then validate and export one package.

@graph.name: MarinOS Foundations Guide
@graph.abstract: A short guide to the architecture and working methods used by MarinOS.

marin:gradeBands.name: A

marin:gradeBands.name: B
marin:gradeBands.marin:message: Strong work. A brief review will close the remaining gaps.

marin:gradeBands.name: C
marin:gradeBands.marin:message: You passed. Review the explanations before presenting this material to others.

marin:gradeBands.name: D
marin:gradeBands.marin:message: Close, but the shared architecture deserves another look.

marin:gradeBands.name: F
marin:gradeBands.marin:message: Review the guide and try again. The App Shell has not taken this personally.
